name: briefproof
description: Describe what to build in plain words; get a working, verified project. Live pane with a capybara per stage, pause, requirements you can steer, and a model per stage to control cost. Run /briefproof:build in Claude Code.

preflight.title: Preflight model
preflight.description: Copies the brief, sets up the repo. 'session' = the model this session runs on.

manifest.title: Manifest model
manifest.description: Splits the brief into verbatim requirements. 'session' = the model this session runs on.

briefing.title: Briefing model
briefing.description: Finds the open questions and asks them. 'session' = the model this session runs on.

spec.title: Spec model
spec.description: Writes the specification and module boundaries. 'session' = the model this session runs on.

plan.title: Plan model
plan.description: Cuts the spec into tickets. 'session' = the model this session runs on.

build.title: Build model
build.description: Executors write the code, reviewers check risky tickets. 'session' = the model this session runs on.

accept.title: Acceptance model
accept.description: Blind check of the finished project against the brief. 'session' = the model this session runs on.

done.title: Done (report) model
done.description: The final report and project memory. 'session' = the model this session runs on.
